About the Programme:
The programme is designed to provide comprehensive legal assistance, case review, and
documentation support to undertrial prisoners at Sabarmati Central Jail, Ahmedabad. It
focuses on the timely identification of eligible prisoners and facilitates the preparation, filing
and effective follow-up of bail applications. In addition, the programme seeks to strengthen
institutional coordination among GNLU, the District Legal Services Authority, prison
authorities, defence counsel and probation officers to expedite bail proceedings. It also
aims to conduct periodic, rights-based legal awareness sessions within the prison to
enhance legal literacy and access to justice among inmates.
 The programme has been supported by Azim Premzi Foundation.
 Geographical Area: Ahmedabad and surrounding areas.
Eligibility Criteria
(i) Project Manager
Essential criteria
 A degree in Law (LL.B./LL.M.).
 Minimum of 4 years' experience in legal practice.
 Must be eligible to appear before the courts as on the date of application.
 Working knowledge of Gujarati language.
Page 2 of 4
 Knowledge of Computer applications.
Desirable:
 Prior experience of working in a legal aid project focused on access to justice, prison
reforms, women, children or other marginalized sections of the society.
Role and responsibilities
 Under the overall supervision of Project Director, the Project Manager shall be the
primary liaison officer and responsible to execute the programme, Supervise, guide
and monitor Legal Fellows and Social Work Fellows. Project Manager shall ensure
overall smooth implementation of programme with timely reporting and financial due
diligence.
(II) Project Fellow (Legal)
Essential criteria
 A degree in Law (LL.B./LL.M.).
 Minimum of 2 years' post qualification experience in legal practice.
 Must be eligible to appear before the courts as on the date of application.
 Working knowledge of Gujarati language
 Knowledge of Computer applications
Desirable:
 Prior experience of working in a legal aid project focused on access to justice, prison
reforms, women, children or other marginalized sections of the society.
Role and responsibilities
 Draft, file and argue the bail petitions and other applications before the competent
courts along with the Gujarat High Court. Project Fellow (Legal) shall be offering
legal advise along with necessary legal documentation work to facilitate the release
of eligible undertrial prisoners on bail. Project Fellow (Legal) shall be responsible to
maintain detailed case records and coordinate with the Project Fellow (Social work)
under the supervision of Project Manager and overall supervision of Project
Director.
 Project Fellow- Legal are allowed to continue their independent legal practice
subject to primary responsibility within the project and with disclosure to the Project
Director. In any case the precedent shall be for programme work.
Page 3 of 4
(III) Project Fellow (Social work)
Essential criteria
 Post Graduate Degree in Social Work or any allied discipline from a recognized
Indian University.
 Minimum of 2 years' post qualification experience of working with a governmental
or non-governmental organization engaging with prison reforms, economically
marginalized sections of society or similar aspects of social work.
 Working knowledge of Gujarati language.
 Knowledge of Computer applications.
Desirable:
 Prior experience of working in similar legal aid project focused on women, children
or other marginalized sections of the society.
Role and responsibilities
 Project Fellow (Social work) shall be responsible to undertake field visits, local travel
as required, maintain detailed case files and report to the Project Coordinator and
Project Director.
 Project Fellow (Social work) shall provide comprehensive support in conducting
need assessments at prisons for undertrial prisoners. The Project Fellow (Social
work) shall Work in close coordination with the Project Fellow (Legal) to provide
psycho-social support and other case related follow-up.
GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS
 Tenure: The initial appointment for abovementioned positions shall be for 11
months. The tenure may be extended based on satisfactory performance, needs
and availability of funds.
 The staff will be purely for the implementation of programme and in any manner will
not be the employee of the Gujarat National Law University or the Azim Premzi
foundation for any purpose.
 Interested candidates fulfilling the above-mentioned criteria must email their
latest Curriculum Vitae (CV) along with supporting education qualification
documents by email to: gnluapfproject@gnlu.ac.in
 Email Subject Line must consist of the Position Applied (e.g., “Application for
Project Fellow- Legal”).
Page 4 of 4
 Only Shortlisted candidates will be notified about the date, time and place of
interview separately by email only. No separate call letters will be sent.
 Travel: No Travel Allowance (T.A.) or Daily Allowance (D.A.) will be paid for
attending the interview.
 Project Director retains the discretion to amend/modify/relax the criteria as
mentioned above or revise the terms of appointment as may be required for
effective implementation of programme.
 Last date of application: 04th April 2026
